_language: Selects the kernel shim that starts this module and talks to it. This module also carries language-specific tests, which is what makes it NON-portable: those tests can only judge a JavaScript implementation.
_why_artifact_side: The toolchain is hashed into the ARTIFACT, not the contract. Change the image and this implementation is re-judged; but a Python implementation of the same interface fills the SAME contract slot rather than inventing a new one.
